title: Mighty Avengers #10 Marvel 2008 Sentry vs Thing Bendis Bagley Secret Invasion
conditionDescription: Bright, light handling wear. See photos.
descriptionText:
The Mighty Avengers #10 (April 2008), Marvel Comics - Secret Invasion: Who Do You Trust? Brian Michael Bendis, Mark Bagley, Danny Miki, Justin Ponsor. Sentry vs. the Thing on the cover. Direct edition, $2.99 cover price.

Back cover: Pirates of the Caribbean Online ad.

Condition: bright with light handling wear (see photos).

Ships bagged in a protective mailer.
